description_en: Commits a file to the development environment of the scheduling system to generate a task
description_zh: 提交文件至调度系统的开发环境，生成对应的任务
name: SubmitFile

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the ID. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the workspace name. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间名称。
您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The file ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
文件的ID，
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.example: Submit a task for the first time
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
Whether to skip the pre-deployment check after the file is submitted:

false: Do not skip. After the file is submitted, the system automatically triggers the pre-deployment check. The file becomes available for deployment only after the check is passed.

true: Skip. After the file is submitted, the system does not trigger the pre-deployment check. The file can proceed directly to deployment
parameters.help_zh:
文件提交成功后是否跳过发布前检查：

false：不跳过。文件提交后会自动触发发布前检查流程，检查通过后才会进入可发布状态。
true：跳过。文件提交后不会触发发布前检查流程，可直接进入发布流程
parameters.name: skip_all_deploy_file_extensions

Data.description_en: The deployment package ID. You must specify this ID as a parameter when you call the [GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html） operation to query the details of the deployment
Data.description_zh: 发布包的ID。后续需要将该ID作为参数调用[GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html）接口，获取本次发布的具体情况

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: success.

false: failure
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。

true：成功。
false：失败
